(women's)]] }}}} '''FCV Farul Constanța''' ({{IPA|ro|ˈfarul konˈstantsa}}), commonly known as '''Farul Constanța''' or simply '''Farul''', is a Romanian professional [[Association football|football]] [[Club (organization)|club]] based in [[Constanța]], [[Constanța County]], that competes in the [[Liga I]], the top tier of the [[Romanian football league system|Romanian league system]]. ''Farul'' means "the Lighthouse" in [[Romanian language|Romanian]], referring to the city's location on the [[Black Sea]] coast. Founded in 1920 as ''SPM Constanța'', the club spent over 40 seasons in the top flight before merging with [[FC Viitorul Constanța|Viitorul Constanța]] in 2021. Before the merger, Farul's best league finishes were three fourth-place results. Farul won its first Liga I title in the [[2022–23 Liga I|2022–23 season]], or its second if Viitorul's honours are included.{{efn|name=FCV|In June 2021, [[FC Viitorul Constanța|Viitorul Constanța]] changed its corporate name to FCV Farul Constanța SA and adopted the Farul name, crest, and colours. [[Gheorghe Hagi]], who controlled Viitorul, stated that the new club would retain Viitorul's honours.{{cite web|url=https://liga2.prosport.ro/seria-1/ce-palmares-va-avea-noul-farul-constanta-gica-hagi-spune-cum-noul-club-la-care-va-fi-actionar-alaturi-de-ciprian-marica-devine-cel-mai-bun-din-romania-la-mai-multe-capitole-prima-19189869|title=Ce palmares va avea noul Farul Constanța? Gică Hagi spune cum noul club la care va fi acționar alături de Ciprian Marica devine "cel mai bun" din România la mai multe capitole. Primarul Constanței a vorbit despre stadiul noului stadion|trans-title=Which will be the honours of the new Farul Constanța? Gică Hagi reveals how the new club where he will be a shareholder along with Ciprian Marica becomes "the best" in Romania in several respects. The mayor of Constanța spoke about the progress of the new stadium|publisher=[[ProSport]]|language=ro|date=21 June 2021|accessdate=15 July 2021|archive-date=15 July 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210715122304/https://liga2.prosport.ro/seria-1/ce-palmares-va-avea-noul-farul-constanta-gica-hagi-spune-cum-noul-club-la-care-va-fi-actionar-alaturi-de-ciprian-marica-devine-cel-mai-bun-din-romania-la-mai-multe-capitole-prima-19189869|url-status=live}} The merger and the attribution of Viitorul's honours to Farul have since been disputed.{{cite web|url=https://stiripescurt.ro/clubul-viitorul-fc-dispare-prin-fuziune-gica-hagi-revine-ca-antrenor-34456/|title=Clubul Viitorul FC dispare, prin fuziune. Gică Hagi revine ca antrenor|trans-title=The Viitorul FC club disappears, through merger. Gică Hagi returns as coach|publisher=stiripescurt.ro|language=ro|date=21 June 2021|accessdate=15 July 2021|archive-date=15 July 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210715123348/https://stiripescurt.ro/clubul-viitorul-fc-dispare-prin-fuziune-gica-hagi-revine-ca-antrenor-34456/|url-status=live}}}} The club is known for its [[Gheorghe Hagi Football Academy|academy]], established by [[Gheorghe Hagi]], a native of Constanța County. Hagi also served as the club's controlling shareholder and head coach, and is the joint all-time leading goalscorer for the [[Romania national football team|Romania national team]]. Farul traditionally played its home matches at [[Stadionul Farul|Farul Stadium]], but currently uses the smaller [[Stadionul Viitorul (Ovidiu)|Viitorul Stadium]] in [[Ovidiu]] until a new stadium is built."}}
